title: Projects
emptySsh: No SSH projects yet. Create an SSH project first.
emptyLocal: No projects yet. Create a project to add employees and tasks.
testCommandPlaceholder: e.g. npm test / cargo test (optional; inherits the global default)

scaffoldHint: Auto-creates tags (bug/feature/chore) and the first MVP milestone so delivery management works out of the box.
errorLocalPathRequired: Local projects require a local repository path.
errorSshRequired: SSH projects require an SSH config and a remote repository directory.
deleteDescription: Delete project “{{name}}”? The project and its tasks will move to the trash and can be restored from there.
repoSelectDesktopOnly: Folder selection is only available in the desktop app
deleteGitContextDescription: Delete the Git context record for task branch “{{branch}}”? This removes the stale record permanently.
worktreeMissingHint: The task worktree no longer exists, so this record can be deleted.
previewDescription: Compare {{before}} and {{after}} with the Monaco Diff Editor.
binaryPlaceholder: /* {{side}} is a binary file; text Diff preview is not supported */
commitDetailDescription: View commit metadata, changed files, and the diff preview.
diffTruncated: This commit diff is long; the preview has been truncated.
noTextDiff: This commit has no text diff to show.
diffHint: Click the path or button to view the diff between the parent commit and this commit.
noChangedFiles: This commit has no changed files to show.

gitActionOptions.merge: Merge task branch into target branch

gitActionDialog.cherryPickPlaceholder:
One commit SHA per line
e.g.:
abc1234
def5678
gitActionDialog.cleanupDeleteBranch: Also delete the task branch on cleanup
gitActionDialog.title: Git high-risk action confirmation gate
gitActionDialog.description: Request first to generate a one-time token, then decide to confirm or cancel. Re-requesting automatically invalidates the old token.
gitActionDialog.existingPendingHint: This context already has an “{{action}}” pending action. Since plaintext tokens are never sent back to the frontend, you can cancel the old gate or request a new action.
gitActionDialog.lockedActionHint: This entry is locked to “{{action}}”. For other Git actions, open the general Git action panel from the project detail page.
gitActionDialog.requestInfo: Generated the “{{action}}” confirmation gate. Confirm to execute or cancel.

gitBranchDialog.title: Branch management
gitBranchDialog.switchDescription: Switch the project repository to the selected branch; the working tree must be clean or the switch is rejected.
gitBranchDialog.createDescription: Create a new branch from the current or a selected branch, optionally switching to it right away.
gitBranchDialog.deleteDescription: Delete the selected local branch; enable force delete if it has unmerged commits.
gitBranchDialog.mergeDescription: Merge the source branch into the target branch; the working tree must be clean first.
gitBranchDialog.defaultDescription: Run branch management operations on the project repository.
gitBranchDialog.selectSwitchError: Select the target branch to switch to.
gitBranchDialog.sameBranchError: The target branch is the same as the current branch.
gitBranchDialog.emptyBranchNameError: The new branch name cannot be empty.
gitBranchDialog.deleteCurrentError: Cannot delete the current branch; switch to another branch first.
gitBranchDialog.selectMergeError: Select both the source and target branches.
gitBranchDialog.sameMergeError: The source and target branches cannot be the same.
gitBranchDialog.switchDirtyHint: The working tree has uncommitted changes, so the switch will fail. Commit, roll back, or stash first.
gitBranchDialog.checkoutAfterCreate: Switch to this branch after creating it (requires a clean working tree)
gitBranchDialog.createDirtyHint: The working tree has uncommitted changes, so “switch after create” will fail. Uncheck it to only create the branch.
gitBranchDialog.forceDelete: Force delete (-D, unmerged commits will be lost)
gitBranchDialog.forceDeleteHint: Force delete skips the merged check; any unpushed/unmerged commits on this branch will be lost permanently. Please confirm.
gitBranchDialog.mergeDirtyHint: The working tree has uncommitted changes, so the merge will be rejected. Commit or stash first.

gitRepoDialog.title: Repository actions
gitRepoDialog.commitDescriptionStaged: {{count}} files are staged; a commit will be created from these changes.
gitRepoDialog.commitDescriptionEmpty: No files are staged yet. Stage changes in the working tree list first.
gitRepoDialog.pushDescription: Push the current branch to the selected remote. For a new branch, specify the branch name.
gitRepoDialog.pullDescription: Pull updates for the current branch from the selected remote, with fast-forward or rebase modes.
gitRepoDialog.defaultDescription: Commit, push, or pull for the project repository.
gitRepoDialog.pullRebaseHint: The working tree has local changes, so rebase pull is selected by default. Keep autostash enabled to avoid pull failures from uncommitted changes.
gitRepoDialog.pullFfHint: The working tree has local changes. For fast-forward only, keep autostash enabled; if “Not possible to fast-forward” appears again, the local branch has diverged from the remote — switch to rebase pull.
gitRepoDialog.noBranchesHint: No branches are available. Make sure the repository is on a valid branch before running this action.
gitRepoDialog.generateErrorNoProject: Project info is incomplete, so the commit message cannot be generated.
gitRepoDialog.generateErrorNoStaged: No files are staged yet, so the commit message cannot be generated.
gitRepoDialog.commitNoStagedError: No files are staged yet. Stage changes before committing.
gitRepoDialog.commitMessageEmptyError: The commit message cannot be empty.
gitRepoDialog.commitPushUnknownBranch: The commit was created, but the current branch is unknown. Push manually from the project page.
gitRepoDialog.commitPushFailed: The commit was created, but the push failed: {{message}}
gitRepoDialog.pushAfterCommitUnknownTitle: The current branch is unknown, so commit & push is unavailable

gitCommitDialog.placeholder: Type a commit message… (Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to commit)

gitChanges.empty: No working tree file changes to show.
gitChanges.browseHint: Browse the file with the built-in code preview
gitChanges.unavailableBrowseHint: This file is not available for preview

worktree.title: Worktree management ({{count}})
worktree.description: View all Git worktrees of the project; preview, stage, roll back, commit, merge, and delete are supported.
worktree.empty: No Git worktrees to show for this project.
worktree.mergeDisabledHint: This worktree does not support direct merge
worktree.removeDisabledHint: The main repository worktree cannot be deleted
worktree.changesPanelDescription: Live changed files of this worktree; Diff can be previewed in the app.
worktree.emptyPrunable: This worktree is prunable; no file changes to show.
worktree.emptyBare: Bare worktrees do not provide a working tree file list.
worktree.emptyChanges: No file changes to show for this worktree.
worktree.lockedNotice: This worktree is locked; unlock it first: {{reason}}
worktree.lockedNoticeGeneric: This worktree is locked. Unlock it before deleting.
worktree.rollbackDescription: This discards all uncommitted local changes in the worktree and cannot be undone.
worktree.removeDescription: This removes the Git worktree; if it still has uncommitted changes, you can choose force delete.

worktreeCommitDialog.title: Commit worktree changes
worktreeCommitDialog.description: Create a local commit from the files staged in this worktree.
worktreeCommitDialog.commitDisabled: This worktree does not exist, so it cannot be committed.
worktreeCommitDialog.generateErrorNoWorktree: This worktree does not exist, so the commit message cannot be generated.
worktreeCommitDialog.generateErrorNoStaged: No files are staged yet, so the commit message cannot be generated.
worktreeCommitDialog.commitNoStagedError: No files are staged yet. Stage changes before committing.
worktreeCommitDialog.commitMessageEmptyError: The commit message cannot be empty.

worktreeMergeDialog.title: Merge worktree
worktreeMergeDialog.description: Merge the branch of this worktree into a target branch; optionally delete the worktree and source branch afterwards.
worktreeMergeDialog.autoStashHint: Uncommitted changes were detected in this worktree. They will be stashed (including untracked files) before the merge and will not be restored afterwards.
worktreeMergeDialog.lockedHint: This worktree is locked; the merge can run, but it cannot be deleted afterwards.
worktreeMergeDialog.deleteBlockedHint: This worktree still has uncommitted changes; to delete it after the merge, enable “auto-stash uncommitted changes”.
worktreeMergeDialog.mergeNoWorktreeError: This worktree does not exist, so the merge cannot run.
worktreeMergeDialog.mergeNoBranchError: This worktree has no bound branch, so the merge cannot run.
worktreeMergeDialog.mergeSameBranchError: The source and target branches cannot be the same.
worktreeMergeDialog.mergeDeleteStashError: To delete the worktree after the merge, enable “auto-stash uncommitted changes” first.

detailPage.gitWorkflowHint: Project-level Git overview, task contexts, and pending action entries.
detailPage.repoActionsHint: Commit, push, and pull directly on the project repository, using the current branch by default.
detailPage.workingTreeDescription: Live changed files of the repository; file contents can be previewed in the app.
detailPage.contextWorktreeMissing: The task worktree no longer exists; this context record can be deleted.
detailPage.noPendingActions: No high-risk Git actions are pending.
detailPage.reconcileSuccess: Fixed the Git context; current state: {{state}}
detailPage.rollbackDescription: This discards all uncommitted local changes and cannot be undone. Please confirm before continuing.
